name: use_group
description: What the parcel or building is used for: current occupancy or taxation grouping (land and buildings)

name: use_subgroup
description: OpenPlaces use subgroup

name: use_group_combined
description: Combined use group and subgroup label

name: purpose_group
description: What the building was built (made) for; not applicable to unimproved land

name: purpose_subgroup
description: Building construction-purpose subgroup

name: purpose_group_combined
description: Combined purpose group and subgroup label

name: occupancy_type
description: Inferred occupancy: residential class (Single-Family / Multi-Family split into HAZUS Low/Mid/High-Rise bands by n_stories / Manufactured Home / RV Dwelling / Secondary) or NSI/parcel non-residential category; also the base for provenance-suffixed evidence variants attributed during harmonize (occupancy_type_building_nsi, occupancy_type_footprint_fema, ...) and curate (occupancy_type_parcel)

name: group
description: OpenPlaces top-level group

name: land_value
description: Assessed land value

name: land_value_imputed
description: Estimated land value for a parcel whose land value is missing or zero despite a positive improvement value and evidence it should carry one (residential land use, or footprint area disproportionate to its use_group_combined peers); a local per-area estimate (street+city cohort, then city-scoped, falling back to a county-wide residential-vs-non-residential average) times the parcel's own lot area

name: improvement_value
description: Assessed improvement value

name: other_value
description: Assessed value of items a roll counts in total_value but in neither land nor building (MassGIS OTHER_VAL: yard items such as sheds, pools and paving), so total = land + improvement + other

name: improvement_value_imputed
description: Improvement value re-derived as improvement_value minus land_value_imputed (clipped at 0), on the parcels land_value_imputed applies to

name: land_value_exempt
description: Assessed land value excluded from taxation (e.g. a tax-exempt owner)

name: land_value_taxable
description: Assessed land value actually subject to taxation

name: land_value_preferential
description: Land value under a preferential-use assessment program (e.g. Pennsylvania Act 319 "Clean and Green" agricultural/forest land)

name: improvement_value_exempt
description: Assessed improvement value excluded from taxation (e.g. a tax-exempt owner)

name: improvement_value_taxable
description: Assessed improvement value actually subject to taxation

name: land_value_prior_year
description: The roll's own land value for the tax year before its tax_year (e.g. HCAD prior_land_val); read by link_by_id's roll_values rule to fill a parcel the current year has not yet valued; not copied onto parcels

name: improvement_value_prior_year
description: The roll's own improvement value for the tax year before its tax_year (e.g. HCAD prior_bld_val); see land_value_prior_year

name: total_value_prior_year
description: The roll's own total value for the tax year before its tax_year (e.g. HCAD prior_tot_mkt_val); see land_value_prior_year

name: structure_value
description: Building's own assessed/replacement value, net of land: the parcel-apportioned improvement value or the NSI-modeled replacement value, chosen per admin unit by which source has usable coverage there, not per building; structure_value_building_nsi is the NSI-only evidence variant

name: year_built
description: Year building was built

name: address
description: Street address

name: address_conflict
description: Address evidence disagreement summary across sources (e.g. 'parcel: 789 ELM ST | dwelling_overture: 999 PINE ST'); null when the sources agree

name: postal_zip5
description: Normalized 5-digit ZIP code used for postal_city lookups

name: postal_city
description: USPS-preferred city name for postal_zip5

name: postal_city_acceptable
description: USPS-acceptable alternate city names for postal_zip5 (joined with '; ')

name: postal_city_unacceptable
description: USPS-unacceptable city names for postal_zip5 (joined with '; ')

name: land_area_sqft
description: Land area as the source states it (the lot, a condominium unit's stated land share, or its development's land), in sqft, as opposed to the geometry's own area_* columns

name: land_area_ac
description: Land area as the source states it (the assessor's record of the lot, a condominium unit's stated land share, or its development's land), in acres, as opposed to the deed's (area_deed_ac) or the geometry's own area_* columns

name: area_deed_ac
description: Parcel area per the recorded deed (as opposed to the assessor's record or computed geometry)

name: area_sqft
description: Own 2D area of the row's entity seen from above, in sqft (lot for a parcel, outline for a footprint)

name: n_stories
description: Number of stories

name: n_dwellings
description: Number of dwelling units in the building

name: height
description: Building height

name: n_sections
description: Number of factory-built sections joined on site to form the structure (1 single-wide, 2 double-wide, 3 triple-wide). Meaningful only for manufactured homes; missing for site-built structures

name: foundation_type
description: Foundation type code (B basement; C crawl; F fill; I pile; P pier; S slab; W solid wall)

name: construction_type
description: Structural construction material code (C concrete; H manufactured; M masonry; S steel; W wood)

name: roof_shape
description: Roof shape classification

name: roof_shape_confidence
description: Classifier confidence in roof_shape

name: roof_shape_2
description: Roof shape classification, second-ranked alternative

name: roof_shape_confidence_2
description: Classifier confidence in roof_shape_2

name: roof_shape_3
description: Roof shape classification, third-ranked alternative

name: roof_shape_confidence_3
description: Classifier confidence in roof_shape_3

name: has_garage
description: Whether the building has a garage

name: height_unconfirmed
description: True where the outline's value per sq ft of footprint is high (a tall drawn height) and its measured floors do not explain it (value per sq ft of floor above the flag's threshold); missing where the outline has no value

name: occupancy_type_base
description: Occupancy class before Multi-Family is split into height bands (pre-refinement occupancy_type)

name: occupancy_type_conflict
description: Occupancy evidence disagreement summary across all sources (e.g. 'nsi: X | fema: Y | parcel: Z'); null when the evidences agree

name: occupancy_type_review
description: Flag where improvement value is a small nonzero share of total value (possible manufactured home for review)

name: p_manufactured_home
description: Probability of manufactured home classification

name: manufactured_home_community
description: Flag where the parcel is classified as a manufactured-home community/park; footprints get the same-named, richer refinement of it (a parcel with more than the threshold count of manufactured-home footprints, per the final footprint occupancy)

name: n_manufactured_homes_per_parcel
description: Number of manufactured-home footprints on the footprint's parcel

name: n_primary_manufactured_homes_per_parcel
description: Number of footprints on the footprint's parcel that are primary on it and that the first occupancy vote classed Manufactured Home; read by the second pass on small secondary footprints

name: manufactured_home_rank_on_parcel
description: Rank of a footprint the first occupancy vote classed Manufactured Home among its parcel's such footprints, 1 for the largest by area_m2 (ties by footprint id); missing on every other footprint

name: n_manufactured_home_units
description: Number of mobile or manufactured home units the appraisal roll or building record lists for the property (one per improvement or building of a mobile-home type); 0 where the record lists buildings but none of that type, missing where the source records no unit types

name: n_travel_trailers
description: Number of travel trailers the appraisal roll lists as improvements of the property (a towable RV assessed as a dwelling unit); 0 where the roll lists other units, missing where the source records no such class

name: n_park_models
description: Number of park-model RVs the appraisal roll lists as improvements of the property; 0 where the roll lists other units, missing where the source records no such class

name: n_residential_buildings
description: Number of residential buildings (main-area improvements of a residential class, mobile homes and RVs included) the appraisal roll lists for the property; a structure count, not a dwelling-unit count

name: has_homestead_exemption
description: Whether the property carries a residence homestead exemption as the appraisal roll records it (Texas: the owner's principal residence)

name: land_use_class
description: Parcel land-use class: rule-based classes (e.g. Manufactured Home Park, RV Park, Townhome, Condominium, Vacant) with defaults voted from group_parcel/group_building_nsi/group_footprint_fema

name: n_footprints_per_parcel
description: Number of footprints on the parcel

name: n_buildings_per_parcel
description: Number of buildings on the building's parcel; the building spine's name for n_footprints_per_parcel

name: n_parcels_per_footprint
description: Number of parcels the footprint overlaps

name: shared_wall_m
description: Longest run of the footprint outline's boundary lying on or inside another outline of at least 20 m2, found by strict intersection (no buffer, no distance tolerance); 0 where no such outline touches it, missing on a synthetic geometry. A party wall of a drawn rowhouse; read by the Manufactured Home decision's guard

name: envelope_id
description: Open Location Code of the envelope a footprint piece was cut from, where a building crossing a unit line was reconciled to one envelope and cut at the line; the pieces of one building share it

name: n_parcels_per_building
description: Number of parcels the building overlaps; the building spine's name for n_parcels_per_footprint

name: n_buildings_per_footprint
description: Number of buildings the footprint outline holds, by the footprint-to-building link: one while each building is one outline, several where one outline draws a row of townhomes

name: n_small_elongated_footprints_per_parcel
description: Number of small elongated (manufactured-home-shaped) footprints on the parcel

name: n_primary_footprints_per_parcel
description: Number of non-accessory footprints on the parcel (excludes secondary/accessory structures)

name: max_footprint_area_m2
description: Largest footprint area on the parcel

name: footprint_area_m2_dominant
description: Total real (non-synthetic) footprint area on the parcel, summed from footprints for which this parcel is the dominant (largest-overlap) parcel -- each footprint's FULL, unclipped area, not the portion actually inside this parcel; can exceed the parcel's own area. See footprint_area_m2_in_parcel for a coverage-safe alternative.

name: footprint_area_m2_in_parcel
description: Real footprint area actually inside this parcel's own boundary: sum, per touching footprint, of its geometry clipped to this parcel (a real geometric intersection), across all footprints -- including non-dominant spillovers -- clearing min_overlap_m2 against this parcel. Bounded by the parcel's own area.

name: footprint_area_m2_primary
description: Total real (non-synthetic) footprint area on the parcel among non-secondary footprints, summed from footprints for which this parcel is the dominant parcel -- same unclipped-area caveat as footprint_area_m2_dominant.

name: footprint_area_share
description: Total footprint area as a share of the parcel's own total area

name: footprint_primary_area_share
description: Total non-secondary (non-accessory) footprint area as a share of the parcel's own total area (can exceed 1.0 for footprints straddling a parcel line -- footprint_area_m2_primary is unclipped)

name: max_parcels_per_footprint
description: Maximum number of parcels linked to any dwelling-confirmed primary footprint on the parcel (from the real, non-FEMA footprint spine)

name: max_dwellings_per_footprint
description: Maximum confirmed dwelling-unit count (Overture) on any single dwelling-confirmed primary footprint on the parcel

name: n_properties_per_parcel
description: Number of individual property/unit records grouped under this parcel, keyed by parcel_id_admin2. Exact where a native property-spine source exists (property_source='source' or 'shared_land_group'); estimated from confirmed footprint/dwelling multiplicity where none does (property_source='estimated')

name: property_source
description: Provenance of this parcel's property/unit count: 'source' (a real per-unit source table, e.g. MassGIS L3_ASSESS), 'shared_land_group' (geometrically inferred from a shared-land parcel group), 'estimated' (no per-unit source, but internal multiplicity evidence exists), or 'none'

name: shared_land_parcel_id
description: Index value of this parcel's shared-land group parcel (a near-zero-land-value parcel this one is entirely enclosed by, alongside >=1 other unit), where detect_shared_land_groups found one

name: year_first_buildup_hisdac
description: First build-up year from HISDAC FBUY raster

name: recorded_date
description: Date the deed was recorded at the registry

name: doc_type
description: Document/instrument type (e.g. deed warranty quitclaim)

name: instrument_number
description: Registry instrument number

name: book
description: Registry book number

name: page
description: Registry page number

name: grantor
description: Grantor (seller) name as recorded

name: grantee
description: Grantee (buyer) name as recorded

name: price
description: Transaction price

name: price_raw
description: Transaction price as provided by the source

name: sale_year
description: Year of the recorded sale

name: sale_month
description: Month of the recorded sale

name: sale_date
description: Date of the recorded sale or closing, where the source states the day; sale_year and sale_month carry the same date for comparison with sources that state only those

name: holding_agency
description: Public agency that acquired and holds the land, in the source's codes (FL-SOLARIS AUTHORIZED_AGENCY_SHORT_NAME: DEP Department of Environmental Protection for the Board of Trustees, SFWMD, SWFWMD, SJRWMD, SRWMD, NWFWMD the five water management districts, FWCC Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission, DACS Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services, COMM FloridaCommerce, DMA Department of Military Affairs, Citrus Department of Citrus)

name: conservation_status
description: Whether the source records the land as held for conservation, in its codes (FL-SOLARIS CONSERVATION_STATUS_IND: Y yes, N no, U unknown; a semicolon list where one land record holds several closings)

name: sale_book
description: Official-record book of the recorded sale

name: sale_page
description: Official-record page of the recorded sale

name: sale_clerk_instrument
description: Clerk instrument number of the recorded sale

name: sale_qualification_code
description: The source's qualification of the sale (arm's length or a disqualification reason)

name: sale_multi_parcel
description: The source's flag that the sale covered several parcels

name: sale_vacant
description: Vacant or improved indicator at the sale

name: parcel_link_method
description: Which rules linked the sale to its parcels, '+'-joined where several did (a deed of several parcels): parcel_id_local (the standardized parcel number, tried first), stacked_units (a unit reaching its lot), assessor_last_sale (a parcel row's own last-sale field), then address_id_local_city, address_id_local and address_range (exact address keys, tried only where the number found nothing); missing where no rule did. A summary of the transaction-to-parcel link table's link_method; the name of a rule, never a score

name: address_points_check
description: On a transaction-to-parcel link row, whether the sale's address key is the key of an address point inside the linked parcel's own polygon: agree; other_parcel (only of points in other parcels); no_point_match (of no point); no_points (the parcel holds no keyed point, as most vacant land); no_sale_address (the sale states none). A fact about the pair, never a score; it adds and removes no link

name: sale_party_relationship
description: How the source says seller and buyer are related (e.g. Wisconsin RETR: No relationship, Financial, Shareholder/partner/member, Family, Other); a source field, never derived from names

name: sale_change_code
description: The source's code for a change to the sale record

name: transaction_id_source
description: The source's own identifier for the sale record

name: sale_document_id
description: Identifier of the recorded document (deed) behind the sale, spelled per source: a clerk instrument number, else book and page. Rows sharing it are one sale.

name: n_parcels_per_sale
description: Number of parcels the recorded document covered

name: sale_arms_length_confidence
description: Graded confidence that the sale was at arm's length, 0 to 1, from the signals the source supplies; a consumer sets its own cutoff

name: sale_qualification_group
description: The source's qualification of the sale as a group: qualified, qualified_parcel_changed, qualified_multi_parcel, pending, removed, disqualified, related_parties (Florida: relatives or affiliated companies), government_transfer (Florida: to or from a government agency, conservation and right-of-way alike),related_parties_family / _business / _financial / _unspecified (Wisconsin: the parties' own statement), not_a_sale (a gift, exchange or other conveyance)

name: sale_double_closing_earlier_leg
description: 1 where a second recorded document for the same parcel at the same price within a month follows this one (the earlier leg of a double closing), else 0; a consumer filters on it

name: sale_record_kind
description: Whether the record is a recorded deed or an assessor's last-sale field

name: sale_matches_deed
description: 1 where an assessor last-sale row has the same parcel, sale year, sale month and price as a recorded deed in the same admin unit (the deed's echo), 0 where it has none, missing on deed rows; a consumer filters on it

name: sale_price_to_assessed_ratio
description: Sale price over the assessed total value at the time of sale

name: sale_nominal_price_floor
description: The price at or below which this source records a nominal consideration rather than a price (Florida 100, North Carolina 0), read off the data as its largest low-price mass point

name: single_family_sales_disclosure_share
description: Share of single-family sales in the entity's admin unit with a disclosed price, a value for a consumer to threshold

name: parcel_id
description: Parcel identifier

name: parcel_id_all
description: All overlapping parcel identifiers (pipe-joined; dominant parcel first by descending intersection area; missing when identical to parcel_id)

name: parcel_id_admin2
description: Parcel identifier unique within its admin-2 unit

name: parcel_id_admin3
description: Parcel identifier unique within its admin-3 unit

name: parcel_id_admin4
description: Parcel identifier unique within its admin-4 unit

name: parcel_id_map
description: Parcel identifier from a secondary map/plat-based numbering system (e.g. VT's Grand List MAPID)

name: parcel_id_upi
description: Parcel's Uniform Parcel Identifier (UPI), where the source assigns one separately from its primary parcel id

name: parcel_id_cama
description: Computer-assisted mass appraisal (CAMA) system identifier for the parcel record

name: parcel_id_tax
description: Tax-roll parcel identifier (assessor PIN)

name: parcel_id_assessor
description: Raw parcel identifier as provided by the source

name: parcel_id_local
description: Standardized, locally cross-comparable parcel matching key

name: property_id_assessor
description: Raw property/unit identifier as provided by the source

name: property_id_admin2
description: Property/unit identifier unique within its admin-2 unit

name: lot_id_local
description: parcel_id_local of the lot a unit sits on, on property rows split off a parcel table at ingest; the row's own parcel_id_local stays the unit's

name: property_id_cama
description: Computer-assisted mass appraisal (CAMA) system identifier for the property/unit record

name: address_id_local
description: Standardized, town-scoped address matching key (no city component)

name: address_id_local_city
description: Standardized address matching key including city (only where city is available)

name: n_transactions
description: Number of recorded transactions on the parcel

name: type
description: Record or unit type or class

name: address_number
description: Street address number

name: address_street_name
description: Street name

name: address_street_type
description: Street type (St Ave Rd etc.)

name: address_street_directional
description: Street directional prefix or suffix (N S E W)

name: address_street
description: Street name with type and directional

name: address_unit_type
description: Address unit type (Apt Suite Unit etc.)

name: address_unit
description: Address unit or suite

name: city
description: City or place name

name: admin3_name
description: Raw admin-3 (county) name as given by the source

name: school_district_name
description: School district name

name: school_district_id
description: School district identifier or code

name: postal_code
description: Postal (ZIP) code

name: legal_description
description: Legal description of the property

name: subdivision
description: Subdivision name

name: subdivision_code
description: Subdivision code

name: plat_id_local
description: Reference of the recorded plat the parcel lies on, as the roll states it (Maryland SDAT PLAT); together with subdivision_code it names one plat, the key on which a plat's lots and its common areas are linked

name: is_common_area
description: Whether the roll's legal description names the parcel a common area or open space of its plat; read from the text at ingest, none of which is kept

name: common_land_share_ha
description: On a lot of a townhouse or condominium plat, its share of the plat's common areas, divided among the plat's lots in proportion to lot area; land the roll counts in the lots' values. An area, never a value

name: common_land_lots_area_ha
description: On a common area linked to its plat's lots, the summed area of those lots

name: n_lots_per_plat
description: On a common area linked to its plat's lots, the number of those lots

name: common_land_plat_id
description: Plat key shared by a common area and the lots it is linked to (admin unit, subdivision code and plat reference); written only on rows the plat key link reached

name: owner_name
description: Owner name as recorded

name: owner_name_2
description: Second owner name as recorded

name: owner_name_january_1
description: Owner of record as of January 1 (the tax-roll assessment date)

name: owner_address
description: Owner mailing street address

name: owner_address_2
description: Owner mailing street address continuation line

name: owner_city
description: Owner mailing city

name: owner_state
description: Owner mailing state or region (raw; use owner_admin2_id_admin1 when resolvable)

name: owner_admin2_id_admin1
description: Owner mailing state/region as the level-2 admin id coded within admin1 (in-country)

name: owner_postal_code
description: Owner mailing postal (ZIP) code

name: owner_relationship
description: Owner's relationship to the property as coded by the source (e.g. joint owner, trustee); explains multiple ownership rows per parcel in a property-entity source

name: clean_and_green
description: Flag/code for enrollment in a preferential-use farm/forest assessment program (e.g. Pennsylvania Act 319 "Clean and Green")

name: zoning_code
description: Zoning classification code

name: tax_district
description: Tax district code

name: tax_year
description: Assessment or tax year

name: tax_neighborhood_code
description: Assessor neighborhood or market-area code

name: deed_reference
description: Recorder of Deeds reference number for the parcel's governing deed

name: use_group_code
description: Source land-use code paired with use_group

name: use_subgroup_code
description: Source land-use code paired with use_subgroup

name: land_use_group
description: Source land-use group classification

name: total_value
description: Total assessed value: land plus structures. Named in full because a bare `value` reads as ambiguous on an entity that also carries land_value, improvement_value and structure_value

name: tax_value_gross
description: Gross property tax amount billed before credits/reductions (a tax bill amount not an assessed value)

name: tax_value_net
description: Net property tax amount billed after credits/reductions (a tax bill amount not an assessed value)

name: market_value
description: Market (just) value

name: special_feature_value
description: Assessed value of special features

name: current_use_value
description: Current-use (present-use) assessed value

name: personal_property_value
description: Assessed value of taxable personal property

name: classified_market_value
description: Classified (present-use) market value

name: last_sale_price
description: Price of the most recent recorded sale

name: last_sale_year
description: Year of the most recent recorded sale

name: last_sale_month
description: Month of the most recent recorded sale

name: last_sale_date
description: Date of the most recent recorded sale

name: last_sale_qualification_code
description: Qualification code of the most recent recorded sale

name: last_sale_vacant
description: Vacant or improved indicator at the most recent sale

name: last_sale_doc_type
description: Deed or instrument type of the most recent sale

name: last_sale_book_page
description: Registry book and page of the most recent sale

name: n_sales
description: Number of recorded sales

name: n_buildings
description: Number of buildings on the parcel

name: n_land_units
description: Number of land units

name: has_structure
description: Whether the parcel has a structure

name: geometry_source
description: Dataset the footprint or parcel geometry came from

name: polygon_type
description: The cadastre's own polygon type (MassGIS POLY_TYPE: FEE, TAX, ROW, PRIV_ROW, RAIL_ROW, WATER); a right-of-way or water type marks a polygon that is not a tax lot

name: spine_resolution
description: Why resolve_spine took this outline from a later source over the earlier ones it overlaps (fragment replaced); missing where the source ranking decided

name: geometry_source_id
description: Identifier of the reference entity whose geometry seeded this row (e.g. the parcel a parcel-inferred footprint copies); missing for rows from the entity's own sources

name: source_date
description: Source last-update date

name: priority_on_parcel
description: Footprint priority on its parcel (primary secondary or unknown)

name: area_m2
description: Footprint area

name: area_ha
description: Parcel lot area

name: area_ac
description: Parcel lot area

name: area_ha_log
description: Natural log of parcel lot area in hectares

name: centroid_x
description: Centroid x coordinate in the spine CRS

name: centroid_y
description: Centroid y coordinate in the spine CRS

name: n_buildings_per_ha
description: Buildings per hectare of parcel lot area

name: lat
description: Centroid latitude (WGS84)

name: long
description: Centroid longitude (WGS84)

name: area_km2
description: Area of the row's own polygon in km2 (an admin unit; a waterbody, as its source states it)

name: area_sqmi
description: Admin area

name: elevation
description: Average elevation

name: slope
description: Average slope of a parcel or surface

name: precipitation_summer
description: Average precipitation, Jun-Aug (30yr normal)

name: precipitation_winter
description: Average precipitation, Dec-Feb (30yr normal)

name: temperature_mean_summer
description: Average temperature, Jun-Aug (30yr normal)

name: temperature_mean_winter
description: Average temperature, Dec-Feb (30yr normal)

name: coastal_water_share
description: Share of coastal waters within a radius

name: lake_distance
description: Distance from the parcel's primary building to the nearest lake at or above a size floor (4 ha by default; the recipe states it). Earlier values from the places model were a parcel-average raster distance

name: lake_frontage
description: Lake shoreline length the parcel holds: shoreline segments allocated to the nearest parcel within a tolerance (earlier places values: buffer-ring area divided by its width)

name: river_frontage
description: River shoreline length the parcel holds, allocated like lake_frontage

name: lake_distance_parcel
description: Distance from the parcel's edge to the nearest lake at or above the size floor, 0 for a parcel touching one: the best building site, before setbacks

name: lake_id
description: NHD waterbody id of the largest lake the parcel fronts

name: lake_area_ha
description: Area of the largest lake the parcel fronts (NHD AreaSqKm)

name: lake_id_nearest
description: NHD waterbody id of the lake nearest the parcel's primary building (or its edge)

name: lake_area_ha_nearest
description: Area of the lake nearest the parcel's primary building (NHD AreaSqKm)

name: river_distance
description: Distance from the parcel's primary building to the nearest river polygon

name: river_distance_parcel
description: Distance from the parcel's edge to the nearest river polygon, 0 for a parcel touching one

name: waterbody_area_share
description: Share of the parcel's area inside NHD waterbody or area polygons (lakes, reservoirs, pools, swamps, rivers)

name: waterbody_id_nhd
description: Permanent_Identifier of an NHD High Resolution waterbody or area feature: a numeric string or a braced GUID, kept as text

name: waterbody_id_nhdplusv2
description: NHDPlus V2 (medium resolution) waterbody COMID

name: waterbody_id_hydrolakes
description: HydroLAKES lake identifier (Hylak_id)

name: waterbody_id_lagos
description: LAGOS-US lake identifier (lagoslakeid)

name: gnis_id
description: Geographic Names Information System (GNIS) feature identifier

name: gnis_name
description: Feature name as the Geographic Names Information System (GNIS) records it

name: road_id_tiger
description: Census TIGER/Line road edge id (LINEARID)

name: feature_code_tiger
description: Census MAF/TIGER feature class code (MTFCC), e.g. S1400 local road, S1500 vehicular trail

name: feature_code_nhd
description: NHD five-digit feature code (FCode): the feature type plus its characteristics, e.g. 39004 perennial lake or pond

name: feature_type_nhd
description: NHD three-digit feature type (FType), e.g. 390 lake or pond, 436 reservoir

name: reach_code_nhd
description: NHD 14-digit reach code of the feature; its first eight digits are the HU8 basin

name: wetland_share
description: Share of area covered by wetland polygons

name: public_land_acquisition_share
description: Share of area overlapping a public land acquisition

name: conservation_easement_share
description: Share of area under a conservation easement

name: protected_land_share
description: Share of area under fee/easement protection, given year and radius

name: protected_open_space_share
description: Share of the parcel's area inside protected or recreational open space polygons (MassGIS OpenSpace in Massachusetts), whatever their level of protection

name: protected_open_space_id
description: Source id of a protected or recreational open space polygon (MassGIS OS_ID: town id and polygon id); on a parcel, the polygon covering most of it

name: protected_open_space_site
description: Site name of a protected or recreational open space polygon (MassGIS SITE_NAME); a site a town line splits keeps one name in each town

name: protected_open_space_level
description: Level of protection of an open space polygon, in the source's codes (MassGIS LEV_PROT: P in perpetuity, T term limited, L limited, N none, X unknown)

name: protected_open_space_owner_type
description: Kind of owner of an open space polygon, in the source's codes (MassGIS OWNER_TYPE: F federal, S state, C county, M municipal, N private nonprofit, P private for profit, B public nonprofit, L land trust, G conservation organization, O other, X unknown, I inholding)

name: protected_open_space_purpose
description: Primary purpose for which open space was protected, in the source's codes (MassGIS PRIM_PURP: R recreation, C conservation, B both, H historical or cultural, A agriculture, W water supply, S scenic, F flood control, U underwater, O other, X unknown)

name: protected_open_space_public_access
description: Legal public access to an open space polygon, in the source's codes (MassGIS PUB_ACCESS: Y yes, N no, L limited to members, X unknown)

name: protected_area_category
description: Protection mechanism of a protected area polygon, in the source's codes (PAD-US Category: Fee, Easement, Other, Designation, Marine, Proclamation); on a parcel, of the polygon covering most of it

name: protected_area_owner_type
description: Kind of owner of a protected area polygon, in the source's codes (PAD-US Own_Type: FED federal, TRIB American Indian lands, STAT state, DIST regional agency special district, LOC local government, TERR territorial, NGO non-governmental organization, PVT private, JNT joint, UNK unknown)

name: protected_area_manager_type
description: Kind of manager of a protected area polygon, in the source's codes (PAD-US Mang_Type, same codes as protected_area_owner_type)

name: protected_area_designation_type
description: Designation type of a protected area polygon, in the source's codes (PAD-US Des_Tp, e.g. NWR national wildlife refuge, SP state park, LP local park, CONE conservation easement, AGRE agricultural easement, FORE forest easement)

name: protected_area_gap_status
description: GAP status of a protected area polygon, the intent to manage it for biodiversity (PAD-US GAP_Sts: 1 permanent protection, natural disturbance allowed; 2 permanent protection, managed for a natural state; 3 protected from conversion, open to extractive uses; 4 no known mandate against conversion)

name: protected_area_public_access
description: Public access to a protected area polygon, in the source's codes (PAD-US Pub_Access: OA open, RA restricted, XA closed, UK unknown)

name: protected_area_year_established
description: Year a protected area polygon was established, as the source records it (PAD-US Date_Est; not populated on every record)

name: conservation_easement_holder_type
description: Kind of holder of an easement polygon, in the source's codes (PAD-US EHoldTyp: the protected_area_owner_type codes, plus REG regional agency)

name: protected_area_share
description: Share of the parcel's area inside protected area fee polygons (land owned outright, any owner; PAD-US Fee), land under overlapping records counted once

name: public_land_share
description: Share of the parcel's area inside fee polygons held by a government owner (PAD-US Fee with Own_Type FED, STAT, DIST, LOC or TERR), land under overlapping records counted once

name: has_public_land
description: Whether public_land_share reaches the threshold the recipe states

name: has_conservation_easement
description: Whether conservation_easement_share reaches the threshold the recipe states

name: conservation_easement_id
description: Source id of an easement polygon; on a parcel, the easement covering most of it

name: conservation_easement_category
description: Protection mechanism of the easement covering most of the parcel (see protected_area_category)

name: conservation_easement_designation_type
description: Designation type of the easement covering most of the parcel (see protected_area_designation_type; PAD-US easement codes CONE, AGRE, FORE, RANE, RECE, HCAE, OTHE, UNKE)

name: conservation_easement_manager_type
description: Kind of manager of the easement covering most of the parcel (see protected_area_manager_type)

name: conservation_easement_gap_status
description: GAP status of the easement covering most of the parcel (see protected_area_gap_status)

name: conservation_easement_public_access
description: Public access to the easement covering most of the parcel (see protected_area_public_access)

name: conservation_easement_year_established
description: Year the easement covering most of the parcel was established, as the source records it (see protected_area_year_established)

name: soil_farmland_local_share
description: Share classified as locally-important farmland soil

name: soil_farmland_prime_share
description: Share classified as prime farmland soil

name: soil_farmland_statewide_share
description: Share classified as statewide-important farmland soil

name: soil_farmland_unique_share
description: Share classified as farmland of unique importance soil (the fourth NRCS class)

name: land_cover_barren_share
description: Land cover share: barren

name: land_cover_cropland_share
description: Land cover share: cultivated cropland

name: land_cover_forest_deciduous_share
description: Land cover share: deciduous forest

name: land_cover_forest_evergreen_share
description: Land cover share: evergreen forest

name: land_cover_forest_mixed_share
description: Land cover share: mixed forest

name: land_cover_forest_share
description: Land cover share: all forest, the sum of the deciduous, evergreen and mixed shares

name: land_cover_grassland_share
description: Land cover share: grassland/herbaceous

name: land_cover_pasture_share
description: Land cover share: pasture/hay

name: land_cover_shrubland_share
description: Land cover share: shrub/scrub

name: building_footprint_share
description: Share of area within a radius covered by building footprints

name: footprint_area_m2
description: Total building footprint area on the parcel

name: n_footprints
description: Count of building footprints on the parcel

name: flood_depth_fluvial
description: Average fluvial flood inundation depth, given return period

name: flood_depth_pluvial
description: Average pluvial flood inundation depth, given return period

name: highway_distance
description: Minimum distance to nearest highway

name: paved_road_distance
description: Minimum distance to nearest paved road

name: travel_time_to_city
description: Travel time to nearest major city

name: household_income_median
description: Median household income

name: population_asian_share
description: Population share: Asian

name: population_black_share
description: Population share: Black/African-American

name: population_hispanic_share
description: Population share: Hispanic

name: population_mixed_race_share
description: Population share: mixed race

name: population_native_american_share
description: Population share: American Indian/Alaska Native

name: population_pacific_islander_share
description: Population share: Native Hawaiian/Pacific Islander

name: population_gravity_index
description: Population gravity: decay-weighted residential population density from a building-footprint-distributed population raster

name: census_tract_id
description: Census tract identifier

name: county_fips
description: County FIPS code (5-digit state+county). On an entity table it is read as the `county` segment of the unit's own national code rather than stored: outside New England it IS admin3_id_admin1, and in New England it is that column's first five characters. A county-level federal reference table (the FHFA house price index) carries it as its key, since New England counties have no admin id. A federal identifier, so unlike admin3_id it survives an openplaces admin-id re-mint and stays joinable to Census, FEMA and other federal products

name: year
description: Calendar year a published statistic refers to: the period key of a reference table (a price index), not an event on an entity

name: house_price_index_base_2000
description: Published house price index with the year 2000 as base (2000 = 100); a ratio of two years gives the published price change between them

name: house_price_index
description: Published house price index as its publisher bases it, which can differ by series (FHFA's county index is 100 in each county's own first year); only a ratio of two years within one series is meaningful

name: house_price_index_annual_change
description: Published percent change of a house price index from the previous year

name: series_id_bls
description: Bureau of Labor Statistics time-series identifier (CUUR0000SA0: CPI-U, US city average, all items, not seasonally adjusted)

name: period_bls
description: Bureau of Labor Statistics period code: M01 to M12 a month, M13 the annual average

name: consumer_price_index
description: Published consumer price index level (CPI-U, 1982-84 = 100); a ratio of two periods gives the published change in consumer prices between them

name: census_blockgroup_id
description: Census block group identifier

name: census_subdivision_id
description: Raw Census county subdivision (COUSUB) identifier for the containing admin4 unit

name: census_block_id
description: Census block identifier (2020 TIGER vintage)

name: census_place_id
description: Census place identifier (7-digit state+place FIPS) of the incorporated place or census-designated place holding the entity; null outside every place

name: census_place_geoid
description: Census place code (7-digit state+place FIPS, TIGER GEOID) on a place tile row of US_tile-census-2025_place; the value link steps copy into census_place_id

name: census_block_geoid
description: Census 2020 tabulation block code (15-digit state+county+tract+block, GEOID20) on a block tile row of US_tile-census-2025_block or a block row of the 2020 Census P.L. 94-171 counts; the value link steps copy into census_block_id

name: n_people
description: Number of people in the census block, 2020 Census P.L. 94-171 table P2 total (P0020001); carries the Census Bureau's disclosure-avoidance noise at block level

name: n_people_white
description: Number of people in the census block who are not Hispanic or Latino and White alone (2020 Census P.L. 94-171, P0020005)

name: n_people_black
description: Number of people in the census block who are not Hispanic or Latino and Black or African American alone (2020 Census P.L. 94-171, P0020006)

name: n_people_asian
description: Number of people in the census block who are not Hispanic or Latino and Asian alone (2020 Census P.L. 94-171, P0020008)

name: n_people_hispanic
description: Number of people in the census block who are Hispanic or Latino, of any race (2020 Census P.L. 94-171, P0020002)

name: n_people_other
description: Number of people in the census block who are not Hispanic or Latino and American Indian and Alaska Native alone, Native Hawaiian and Other Pacific Islander alone, Some Other Race alone, or of two or more races (2020 Census P.L. 94-171, P0020007 + P0020009 + P0020010 + P0020011); with the four other n_people_ groups it sums to n_people

name: zcta5_id
description: ZIP Code Tabulation Area (5-digit) identifier -- a Census statistical approximation of ZIP code service areas, not the authoritative ZIP code (see postal_zip5)

name: postal_code_conflict
description: ZIP-code evidence disagreement summary across sources feeding postal_zip5 (e.g. address-parsed vs. zcta5_id); null when sources agree

name: land_value_per_ha_log_region_nb
description: Predicted land value per hectare (natural log, real USD, deflated to a reference date); 'region-nb' model

name: land_value_per_ha_log_region_nb2
description: Same; 'region-nb2' model (alternate neighborhood-region spec)

name: land_value_per_ha_log_county
description: Same; 'county' model (sales from the parcel's county)

name: land_value_per_ha_log_county_nb
description: Same; 'county-nb' model (sales from the county and counties within 10 km)

name: land_value_per_ha_log_region
description: Same; 'region' model (sales from the parcel's core-based region)

name: land_value_per_ha_log_region_nb_bare
description: Same; 'region-nb' model on the Fathom-free 'bare' predictor set (location, date, size, building footprints)

name: land_value_per_ha_log_region_nb_people
description: Same; 'region-nb_bare' predictors plus population gravity

name: land_value_per_ha_log_region_nb_buildings
description: Same; 'region-nb_bare' predictors plus building footprint shares (500 m and 5000 m)

name: land_value_per_ha_log_region_nb_wealth
description: Same; 'region-nb_bare' predictors plus block-group median household income

name: land_value_per_ha_log_region_nb_peoplewealth
description: Same; 'region-nb_bare' predictors plus population gravity and median household income

name: land_value_per_ha_log_region_nb_peoplebuildings
description: Same; 'region-nb_bare' predictors plus population gravity and building footprint shares

name: land_value_per_ha_log_region_nb_popbldwealth
description: Same; 'region-nb_bare' predictors plus population gravity, building footprint shares and median household income

name: dissimilarity_index
description: Dissimilarity of an observation to a model's training sales in importance-weighted predictor space (Meyer & Pebesma 2021), before division by the area-of-applicability threshold

name: aoa
description: Area of Applicability: rescaled dissimilarity to a model's training feature space (<=0 within domain, >0 extrapolation)

name: area_of_applicability_region_nb_bare
description: Area of applicability of land_value_per_ha_log_region_nb_bare: the parcel's dissimilarity index divided by the threshold from cross-validation folds blocked by census block group; at most 1 is inside the area of applicability, above 1 the prediction extrapolates

name: area_of_applicability_region_nb_people
description: Same; for land_value_per_ha_log_region_nb_people

name: area_of_applicability_region_nb_buildings
description: Same; for land_value_per_ha_log_region_nb_buildings

name: area_of_applicability_region_nb_wealth
description: Same; for land_value_per_ha_log_region_nb_wealth

name: area_of_applicability_region_nb_peoplewealth
description: Same; for land_value_per_ha_log_region_nb_peoplewealth

name: area_of_applicability_region_nb_peoplebuildings
description: Same; for land_value_per_ha_log_region_nb_peoplebuildings

name: area_of_applicability_region_nb_popbldwealth
description: Same; for land_value_per_ha_log_region_nb_popbldwealth

name: effective_year_built
description: Assessor's effective year built: the construction year implied by condition after improvements, not the actual one. Distinct from year_built and from renovation_year, and often the better-populated of the three

name: renovation_year
description: Year of the most recent recorded remodel or renovation

name: n_rooms
description: Number of rooms in the building

name: n_bedrooms
description: Number of bedrooms in the building

name: n_bathrooms
description: Number of bathrooms, each half bath counted as 0.5 (two full baths and one half bath read 2.5). A source that records quarter or three-quarter baths keeps them as 0.25 and 0.75. Where a source publishes full baths only, this is the full count; n_half_bathrooms carries the half count where the source separates it

name: n_half_bathrooms
description: Number of half bathrooms (a toilet and sink, no bath or shower), where the source records them separately. Each is already counted as 0.5 in n_bathrooms

name: heating_type
description: Heating system type as described by the source

name: has_basement
description: Whether the building has a basement

name: building_style
description: Architectural or construction style of the building as described by the source (e.g. ranch, conventional, double-wide). A structure descriptor, not a land use: do not map it to use_group

name: building_type_code
description: The source's code for what the building is used as (e.g. a code meaning garden apartments, low-rise office or distribution warehouse), kept as the source writes it; curate translates it. Unlike building_style it names a use, and unlike use_group_code it describes the building, not the account's tax class

name: conveyance_type
description: What a recorded sale conveyed (e.g. land only vs land plus improvements). Distinct from doc_type, which is the instrument; the transaction-side counterpart of the parcel attribute last_sale_vacant

name: living_area_sqft
description: Finished, heated living area of the building as the assessor reports it (living, heated or finished area). Excludes garages, unfinished basements, porches and decks. Distinct from gross_floor_area_sqft (all enclosed floor area) and from area_sqft (the row's own 2D area seen from above, not a floor area)

name: gross_floor_area_sqft
description: Gross floor area: all enclosed floor area on all floors, including unfinished and non-living space (garage, unfinished basement), as the source reports it

name: quality_grade
description: Assessor's construction quality grade in the source's own codes (a letter or numeric class, e.g. 'C+' or '4'); not harmonized across sources

name: condition
description: Assessor's rating of the building's physical condition in the source's own codes (e.g. poor, fair, average, good); not harmonized across sources

name: exterior_wall
description: Exterior wall material as described by the source (e.g. brick, vinyl siding, stucco, frame)

name: roof_material
description: Roof covering material as described by the source (e.g. asphalt shingle, metal, tile); distinct from roof_shape

name: heating_fuel
description: Heating fuel as described by the source (e.g. gas, electric, oil, wood); distinct from heating_type, the system

name: has_central_air
description: Whether the building has central air conditioning

name: garage_type
description: Garage type as described by the source (e.g. attached, detached, built-in, basement)

name: n_garage_spaces
description: Number of garage parking spaces (car capacity)

name: garage_area_sqft
description: Garage floor area

name: detached_garage_area_sqft
description: Floor area of detached garages, kept out of gross_floor_area_sqft (a detached garage is usually its own footprint) so curate can add it back where no separate footprint exists for it

name: has_carport
description: Whether the property has a carport

name: n_parking_spaces
description: Number of off-street parking spaces as the source reports them (garage, carport, driveway or deeded spaces); common for urban lots and condominium units

name: basement_area_sqft
description: Basement floor area, finished and unfinished

name: basement_finished_area_sqft
description: Finished part of the basement floor area

name: has_pool
description: Whether the property has a swimming pool as the source records it

name: n_fireplaces
description: Number of fireplaces as the source counts them (openings or stacks)

name: porch_area_sqft
description: Porch floor area, open and enclosed

name: deck_area_sqft
description: Deck and patio area

name: has_elevator
description: Whether the building has a passenger elevator

name: n_outbuildings
description: Number of detached accessory structures the source records (sheds, barns, detached garages)

name: has_solar
description: Whether the property has solar panels as the source records it

name: has_accessory_dwelling
description: Whether the property has a secondary dwelling unit (accessory dwelling, in-law unit, garage apartment)

name: unit_floor
description: Floor a condominium or apartment unit sits on, numbered as the source numbers it

name: sewer_type
description: Sewage disposal as described by the source (e.g. public sewer, septic)

name: water_source
description: Water supply as described by the source (e.g. public, private well)

name: frontage_ft
description: Lot frontage along the street

name: has_waterfront
description: Whether the lot fronts on a water body as the source records it

name: view_rating
description: Assessor's view rating in the source's own codes (for a condominium unit, the unit's view); not harmonized across sources

name: topography
description: Lot topography as described by the source (e.g. level, rolling, steep)

name: construction_description
description: Structural construction or frame type in the source's own words or codes (e.g. frame, masonry, wood; a county's class letters). Kept as the county defines it; curate translates it into construction_type

name: foundation_description
description: Foundation type in the source's own words or codes (e.g. slab, crawl space, full basement). Kept as the county defines it; curate translates it into foundation_type

name: dwelling_type_description
description: Dwelling or unit type in the source's own words or codes (e.g. standard, end unit, garden condo, mobile home, parking space). Kept as the county defines it; curate translates it into occupancy and attachment indicators

name: transaction_year_end
description: Year a use-rights contract (e.g. a PES agreement) ended; missing while it runs

name: price_real
description: Transaction price re-expressed in base-year currency with a consumer price index; the base year and currency are stated by the recipe that wrote it (deflate_values)

name: price_real_per_ha_log
description: Natural log of price_real per hectare of the transacted polygon

name: price_period
description: Period a price refers to: total (a lump sum) or year (a recurring payment)

name: area_ha_nominal
description: Area as stated in the transaction record, as opposed to area_ha measured from the polygon

name: area_ratio
description: Ratio of stated to measured area (area_ha_nominal / area_ha); a sanity check on the polygon a record was joined to

name: source_list
description: Semicolon-separated list of the agencies or documents a compiled record was assembled from

name: exclude
description: Analyst flag (1) marking a record to leave out of every analysis, with the reason in the source's own notes

name: exclude_area
description: Analyst flag (1) marking a record whose polygon area disagrees with its stated area beyond tolerance

name: funding_type
description: Who funds a use-rights contract: public or private

name: program_dropped
description: Whether a use-rights contract ended by the participant leaving the program (1) rather than running to term (0)

name: geometry_source_file
description: Name of the spatial source a compiled record's polygon was taken from

name: subregion_id
description: Identifier of a sub-national planning subregion the entity lies in (e.g. a regional environmental authority's subregions), assigned by link_geographic_ids from a reference polygon layer

name: travel_time_nelson
description: Travel time to the nearest city of 50,000 or more, Nelson et al. 2019 surface

name: travel_time_weiss
description: Travel time to the nearest city, Weiss et al. 2018 accessibility surface

name: built_share
description: Share of the polygon classified as built-up in the named source raster

name: road_distance_osm
description: Distance to the nearest OpenStreetMap road

name: road_distance_groads
description: Distance to the nearest gROADS road

name: road_distance
description: Distance to the nearest road in a regional road layer named by the recipe

name: stream_distance
description: Distance to the nearest stream or water body in a regional water layer named by the recipe

name: lights_dmsp
description: DMSP-OLS stable nighttime lights (digital number)

name: biomass_aboveground
description: Aboveground woody biomass density

name: tree_cover_share
description: Share of the polygon under tree cover in the named source raster

name: agricultural_rent
description: Modelled agricultural land rent per square kilometre

name: protected_strict_share
description: Share of the polygon inside strictly protected areas (the categories are named by the recipe)

name: protected_share
description: Share of the polygon inside any protected area of the named registry

name: protected_area_id
description: Identifier of the protected area covering the largest share of the polygon

name: population_density
description: Resident population per square kilometre of the containing admin unit

name: displaced_share
description: Persons forcibly displaced from the containing admin unit as a share of its resident population

name: transaction_group_id
description: Identifier shared by the records of one transaction that the source split across several polygons (e.g. a multi-parcel purchase recorded per parcel)

name: admin2_name
description: Name of the containing admin level 2 unit as written by the source

name: structure_value_adjusted
description: structure_value moved from the roll's appraisal date to a common year with a published county house price index; the common year is stated in the delivery's notice

name: appraisal_year
description: Year of the appraisal date a county roll's values reflect (its latest revaluation effective on or before the roll year)

name: index_year
description: Year an index value refers to

name: land_value_region_id
description: Core-based land-value region an entity lies in: PLACES lab regions grown from high-value cores (CBSA centers, resorts, secondary cities) over the 2010 land value gradient, meeting at its local minima

name: land_value_region_type
description: Kind of core that defines the land-value region: metro, micro (CBSA centers), city (secondary city) or rec (resort)

name: distance_to_land_value_core_km
description: Straight-line distance from an entity's centroid to the core of its land-value region

name: land_value_per_ha_log_2010
description: Estimated 2010 land value at an entity's centroid, natural log of 2017 USD per hectare (Nolte 2020, PNAS; model on vacant and non-vacant sales)
